description: Backend-tier coverage baseline. Scope is src/modules/** and src/server/** — the code whose behaviour only exists with a real PostgreSQL attached. Measured by `npm run test:backend -- --coverage` inside the integration-tests job.
establishmentNote: DELIBERATELY UNSET. The initiative requires measure-first: this tier has never been measured, so inventing a number here would be a guess dressed as a baseline. The first GitHub-hosted run records the measurement, the numbers are committed in a reviewable change, and the ratchet starts from the run after that. Until `global` is populated the gate reports the measurement and passes.

plannedCriticalModules.why: every scope decision in the product
negative stock, reservation locks, exact quantities
exact money arithmetic and discount authorization
replay must not duplicate state, audit or events

plannedCriticalModulesNote: These become enforced `criticalModules` entries once the first hosted measurement proves each prefix matches real files. coverage-gate.mjs FAILS a rule whose prefix matches nothing, so a floor cannot be added blind — that is the intended safeguard, not an obstacle to work around.
